statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of five representative public templates/flows. Authenticated account states, registration completion, uploads, complaints/removal submissions, and exhaustive pagination were not covered because they require credentials, destructive/user-data actions, or repeat an audited template.

page.framework: Server-rendered MPA with jQuery 2.1.3 and third-party ShareThis/Matomo-like scripts
page.notes: Root redirects to /home.html. Distinct home, listing, gallery, auth, and error templates were sampled.

paths.description: Entry/landing template and primary discovery actions; represents the root redirect and marketing/search surface.
Fresh-gallery index; represents content grids, global navigation, pagination, search, image delivery, and install/share chrome.
Representative detail template reached from the listing; covers content metadata, gallery reading entry, mixed-language text, and media presentation.
Primary authentication form; covers credential labels, autofill, focus, CAPTCHA, and account-entry metadata.
Invalid-route recovery template; represents HTTP error messaging and recovery navigation.

findings.summary: The interface forces one dark palette instead of honoring the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The light-scheme evaluate probe reports color-scheme: normal while body remains rgb(15,15,15) with rgb(215,215,215) text; the same hard-dark surface is shown under the dark/reduced condition.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and derive surfaces, text, form controls, and theme-color from prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Navigation and menu state changes are abrupt and do not use view transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition rules and the modern-CSS probe returned no matching view-transition styles; page changes are ordinary full-document swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin navigations with @view-transition { navigation: auto } and add reduced-motion-safe names only where continuity helps orientation.

findings.summary: The fixed navigation and share chrome do not react to scroll state.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection shows a fixed header and fixed ShareThis bar but no scroll-state container query, progress indicator, or scroll-aware shrinking behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state-aware CSS or a lightweight progressive enhancement to reduce fixed chrome after scrolling while retaining navigation access.

findings.summary: A persistent third-party sharing bar occupies content space and has no clear mobile dismissal.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 listing and login screenshots show a fixed ShareThis strip across the bottom; the injected CSS adds 48px body padding and hides the desktop toggle on mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the always-on share bar. Put sharing behind an explicitly labelled, user-invoked popover with native light-dismiss.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is controlled only by viewport breakpoints, not component containers.
findings.evidence: The modern-CSS probe found zero @container rules, while the listing stylesheet relies on global media queries.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable gallery, navigation, and search components containment and use size container queries for local adaptations.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is removed from important inputs and icon buttons, and some targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline: none and no box-shadow on the search input and icon buttons; the interaction probe counts four rendered targets below 24px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator and increase all interactive hit areas to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking legacy scripts and external styles delay the content path.
findings.evidence: The HAR confirms parser-inserted, non-deferred jQuery and main.js plus three VeryHigh-priority stylesheets; the trace measured LCP 3059.61ms despite zero blocking tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the jQuery dependency where possible, defer non-critical scripts, self-host/subset fonts and icons, and keep only critical CSS in the render path.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused JavaScript for basic listing behavior.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 41 KiB savings: 65.96% of jQuery and 42.87% of ShareThis JavaScript were unused; the HAR attributes 117,219 transferred bytes to scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace simple jQuery interactions with platform APIs and load sharing code only after the user invokes sharing.

findings.summary: Search, menu, pagination, and sign-in fields lack accessible names or labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails label, button-name, and link-name. It identifies the unlabelled search input, search and hamburger buttons, and next/last links; login DOM shows both credential fields have zero associated labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add persistent <label> elements for inputs and concise accessible names for every icon-only button/link; keep visible text and accessible names aligned.

findings.summary: Focus visibility and heading structure are incomplete across primary paths.
findings.evidence: Focused login input computes outline none and box-shadow none; the login page has no headings, while Lighthouse reports the listing jumps from h1 to h3.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a descriptive h1 to sign-in, fix heading order, and provide visible :focus-visible styles without globally suppressing outlines.

findings.summary: The navigation logo is distorted and grossly oversized for its rendered use.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports a 53x38 displayed ratio versus 1334x870 intrinsic ratio; the images primitive records the 1334px PNG displayed at 53px wide.
findings.suggestedFix: Export a correctly proportioned, appropriately sized SVG/WebP logo and keep intrinsic width/height consistent with its aspect ratio.

findings.summary: Important pages lack descriptive metadata and rich entity signals.
findings.evidence: The login page title is only “Hentai.name” and its meta description is empty. DOM probes found no canonical, Open Graph, or JSON-LD metadata on login, while sitemap.xml returns the styled 404 document.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every template a unique title and description; add canonical and accurate Open Graph/schema.org metadata on public gallery pages; publish a real sitemap.

findings.summary: Core browser security headers are absent and analytics cookies are not Secure.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive finds no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. Both observed first-party analytics cookies omit Secure; one persists for 393 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and shorten analytics retention.

findings.summary: Third-party sharing, analytics, ads/push, fonts, and CDN calls dominate the network footprint without an observed consent control.
findings.evidence: The tracker capture sees 12 third-party origins. The HAR records 35/50 requests and 592,424/677,797 transferred bytes as third-party, including ShareThis, bregato.com, xedo.me, Google Fonts, and cdnjs.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-essential third parties, self-host static assets, gate optional analytics/sharing behind informed consent, and document retention and purpose.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and lacks passkey support.
findings.evidence: The sign-in DOM contains only username/email and password fields plus reCAPTCHA; no WebAuthn/passkey affordance or credential API usage was observed. Lighthouse confirms no permission prompt on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add discoverable passkey sign-in and registration alongside a correctly annotated password fallback; request any browser permission only after a relevant user action.

findings.summary: Multilingual gallery content is not marked up for language changes and locale-sensitive data is hard-coded.
findings.evidence: The gallery displays English and Japanese text under a single html lang=en with no per-fragment lang/dir metadata, and renders the upload date as the fixed numeric string 2026-07-04.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark language changes with lang/dir, use logical CSS properties, and format dates/numbers through Intl for the selected locale.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit autocomplete tokens and rely on placeholders instead of durable labels.
findings.evidence: The login probe reports empty autocomplete values and zero labels for username/email and password.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete="username" and autocomplete="current-password", persistent labels, and suitable inputmode/autocapitalize values.

findings.summary: Third-party code and decorative sharing UI consume a disproportionate share of a simple listing load.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 592,424 bytes and 35 requests; ShareThis alone adds script, configuration, count, and icon traffic while its fixed UI persists across the session.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, remove persistent sharing code, self-host essentials, and lazy-load optional features after interaction.

findings.summary: The site advertises installation but the audited page was not controlled by a service worker.
findings.evidence: A valid manifest and visible Install App entry exist, but the runtime probe reports navigator.serviceWorker.controller=false, so no offline fallback was active for the tested page.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure a registered service worker controls installed-scope pages and provide a useful offline shell/fallback for previously visited listings and galleries.

taskList.title: Add accessible names, persistent labels, heading order, and visible keyboard focus
Deploy a complete browser security-header policy and secure cookie defaults
Reduce and consent-gate the third-party analytics, push, font, and sharing footprint
Remove parser-blocking legacy/unused JavaScript and simplify the critical resource path
Complete canonical, sitemap, social, structured, and per-template metadata
Add passkey authentication and correct sign-in autocomplete tokens
Honor color-scheme and add container-responsive, reduced-chrome navigation
Fix logo sizing and set an explicit asset/third-party budget
Make installability real with a controlling service worker and offline fallback
Mark mixed-language content and locale-format dates
Progressively enhance navigation continuity with reduced-motion-safe view transitions
